summary: YY Group Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K to disclose the relaunch of its at-the-market (ATM) offering program, originally announced in February 2026, under which it may sell up to $20 million of Class A ordinary shares through agents Spartan Capital and Wilson-Davis. The offering was paused on March 30, 2026, and resumed on April 28, 2026, with approximately $16.5 million of capacity remaining. This is a routine capital-raising activity, not a special situation event.
